claim_boundary: Explicit host input intervention baseline, no native HCC fact memory or generalization claim. Within-channel paired comparisons only; channel memories differ. No independent samples.

predictions.binary_has_no_fact_intervention: No edge value is inferred from binary feedback.
predictions.matching_retrieval_corrects: Under fixed closed world, edge lookup adopts False while record-only retains wrong True, for each gate.
predictions.scope_mismatch_preserves_input: Other context or new epoch yields unknown retrieval and preserves the input.
predictions.silent_change_can_make_retrieval_wrong: Unannounced change with same exposed scope can make old lookup wrong while original observation is correct.
predictions.truthful_observation_suffices: Correct initial observation permits correct adoption without a fact table.

scope_source: Explicit baseline metadata authored for re-exposure; not inferred from historical IDs and not native API fields.
stopping: One 60-cell frozen evaluation, no new learning or retry; prediction failure is a result, not an execution failure.

units.binary_correctness_payload_bits: One earlier correctness Boolean, not Shannon information; correction feedback metadata also remains in edge channel memory.
units.edge_value_bits: Number of explicit Boolean edge values, not entropy or independent samples.
units.retrieved_edge_value_bits: Scope-matched Boolean records; not a guarantee of current-world truth under silent change.
